stories.title: ICBA Africa on advancing evidence-based dialogue on low and no-calorie sweeteners across Africa
stories.summary: ICBA Africa is leading discussions on low and no-calorie sweeteners across several African nations. These roundtables aim to advance evidence-based dialogue within the beverage industry.
stories.angle: This initiative promotes informed discussions on important health-related topics across the continent.
